newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Alvord USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
Alvord Unified School District
(Riverside County, California)
General Obligation Bonds
Election 1997, Series A
(Bank Qualified)
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government
Code Section 53692, that the Board of Trustees of the Alvord
Unified School District, California (the
District'
invites bids for the purchase of $12,000,000 aggregate
principal amount of Alvord Unified School District
(Riverside County, California) General Obligation Bonds
Election 1997, Series A (Bank Qualified). Bids will be
received on
TUESDAY, JULY 22, 1997
at 10:00 a.m. (or each Tuesday thereafter, at the same time
and place, if satisfactory bids are not received on such
date), at the office of the financial advisor to the Alvord
Unified School District, Andrew Ach & Associates, Inc., One
Post Street, Suite 2525, San Francisco, California 94104,
and the sale will be awarded by the District within twenty-
four (24) hours. Further information, including copies of
the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale
and Bid Form, may be obtained from the financial advisor at
the above address, or by telephone at (415) 546-6460.
Dated: July 2, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
